title.zh-CN: 肠癌术后右髋疼痛 · 29岁女性
title.en: Right hip pain after bowel cancer surgery · 29-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻女性在肠癌手术和化疗之后出现髋部疼痛：从病史、查体和既往记录出发找出原因，想清楚这对她的家人意味着什么，并陪她走过之后的病程。
summary.en: A young woman with hip pain after bowel cancer surgery and chemotherapy: find the cause from her history, examination and records, think through what it means for her family, and stay with her through what follows.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把直肠癌治疗后新出现的骨痛，合并质硬的左锁骨上淋巴结和腰椎压痛，按转移复发处理直至排除，并读懂分期PET-CT报告的各个部位。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat new bone pain with a hard left supraclavicular node and lumbar tenderness after rectal cancer treatment as metastatic recurrence until proven otherwise, and read a staging PET-CT report site by site.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 选择最容易、最安全的病灶取组织（先查血常规和凝血），并申请MMR/MSI、RAS、BRAF检测，以指导全身治疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose the most accessible, safest lesion for tissue (blood count and clotting checked first) and request MMR/MSI, RAS and BRAF testing to guide systemic treatment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ESE/ENSAT 2023处理肿瘤患者性质不明的肾上腺病灶：先测甲氧基肾上腺素类；除非已排除嗜铬细胞瘤且病理会改变处理，否则不做活检。
learningOutcomes.en: Handle an indeterminate adrenal lesion in a patient with cancer as ESE/ENSAT 2023 advises: metanephrines first, and no biopsy unless phaeochromocytoma is excluded and histology would change management.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释父母和姐姐肠镜正常为什么不能排除遗传性息肉病（APC新发变异、MUTYH隐性遗传），并按BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020安排先为患者本人做胚系检测、再为亲属做预测性检测和随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why normal colonoscopies in her parents and older sister do not exclude an inherited polyposis (de novo APC variants, recessive MUTYH), and arrange germline testing of the patient first, then predictive testing and surveillance for relatives (BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为疼痛性骨转移制定方案：无并发症时单次8 Gy放疗、口腔检查后用骨改良药物并补充钙和维生素D、规律止痛，出院前交代脊髓压迫警示症状（ESMO 2020；NICE NG234 2023）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan care for painful bone metastases: single 8 Gy radiotherapy when uncomplicated, a bone-modifying agent after a dental check with calcium and vitamin D, regular analgesia, and cord compression warning signs before discharge (ESMO 2020; NICE NG234 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把腰椎转移患者新出现的排尿困难和下肢水肿当作可能的脊髓/马尾受压（24小时内MRI；NICE NG234 2023），再次放疗前先向放疗科核实她既往实际接受的剂量，并在她拒绝住院时评估决策能力、商定她能接受的处理、交代返诊指征，而不是放弃照护。
learningOutcomes.en: Respond to new difficulty passing urine and leg swelling in a patient with lumbar metastases as possible cord or cauda equina compression (MRI within 24 hours; NICE NG234 2023), confirm the doses she actually received with the radiotherapy department before any further radiotherapy, and meet her refusal of admission by checking capacity, agreeing what she will accept and safety-netting — without withdrawing care.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编（原文为中文）。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容——29岁女性，青春期起反复腹痛、腹泻、便血（中文提取为十几年，英文提取为17年）；全结肠多发息肉（管状及绒毛管状腺瘤）伴直肠中高分化腺癌、淋巴结6/27阳性，行直肠及全结肠切除、回肠造口和12次FOLFOX6化疗；父母及姐姐肠镜无明显异常；右髋痛3个月，左锁骨上约1 cm质硬淋巴结，右髋及腰椎轻压痛；PET-CT示盆壁、腹膜后及左锁骨上淋巴结和右髋臼、L3、L5异常摄取，考虑转移，左肾上腺饱满；临床及病理诊断家族性腺瘤性息肉病，未记录胚系检测结果；骨保护和髋部、腰椎放疗，住院时疼痛缓解、之后持续，拒绝进一步全身化疗；数月后下肢及外阴水肿、排尿困难，建议住院被拒绝——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（包括数月后的门诊复诊场景）、决策、处置选项、评分和医护角色均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、化验、息肉数量、胚系及肿瘤分子结果、骨保护药物、真实放疗剂量、拒绝的原因、生存情况）保持未知。1.0.0版中文与英文表述不一致之处两种读法均保留，并列入README“待核实”。原报告无获准展示的图片。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report (written in Chinese). Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 29-year-old woman with recurrent abdominal pain, diarrhoea and bleeding since adolescence (more than ten years in the Chinese extraction, 17 years in the English); multiple polyps throughout the colon (tubular and tubulovillous adenomas) with a moderately to well differentiated rectal adenocarcinoma and 6 of 27 nodes positive, treated by rectal and total colonic resection with an ileostomy and 12 cycles of FOLFOX6; colonoscopies without obvious abnormality in her parents and older sister; three months of right hip pain, a hard left supraclavicular node of about 1 cm and mild right hip and lumbar tenderness; a PET-CT with abnormal uptake in pelvic-wall, retroperitoneal and left supraclavicular nodes, the right acetabulum, L3 and L5 considered metastases, and a bulky left adrenal; a clinical and pathological diagnosis of familial adenomatous polyposis with no germline result recorded; bone protection and radiotherapy to the hip and lumbar spine, with pain relief in hospital that did not last, and further systemic chemotherapy declined; months later lower-limb and vulval oedema with difficulty passing urine, and advised admission declined — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases (including the later clinic visit), decisions, intervention options, scoring and staff are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, blood results, the number of polyps, germline and tumour molecular results, the bone-protective drug, the real radiotherapy doses, her reasons for declining, survival) stays unknown. Where the Chinese and English texts of version 1.0.0 differ, both readings are kept and listed under To verify in the README. The report has no figure approved for display.

The patient facts are those extracted from the published report for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full source article. The case is not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician: have an oncologist, clinical geneticist or gastroenterologist review it before teaching use.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结局取自原报告；你的选择不会改变已发表的病程，也不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and outcome come from the report; your choices do not change it, and unrecorded physiology is not simulated.

chiefComplaint.en: Right hip pain for three months

triageNote.zh-CN: 29岁女性，既往肠道手术（回肠造口）及术后化疗，因右髋疼痛3个月入院。既往病历和检查报告可在病房护士站电脑上调阅。
triageNote.en: 29-year-old woman admitted with three months of right hip pain; earlier bowel surgery with an ileostomy, then chemotherapy. Her earlier records and reports are on the ward station computer.

personality.zh-CN: 29岁女性，青春期起就有肠道毛病，做过肠道手术（回肠造口）和化疗。她的性格、顾虑和意愿都没有记录：如实扮演，不要自行添加情绪或理由。
personality.en: A 29-year-old woman who has had bowel trouble since adolescence and has been through a bowel operation with an ileostomy and chemotherapy. Her temperament, fears and wishes are not recorded: play her plainly and add no feelings or reasons of your own.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用日常口语；治疗名称按医生告诉她的说（回肠造口、FOLFOX6化疗），检查结果让医生去看病历。
speechStyle.en: Plain everyday words; she names her treatments the way her doctors told her (an ileostomy, FOLFOX6 chemotherapy) and leaves test results to the records.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生您好，我右边髋部疼了3个月了。
openingLine.en: Hello, doctor. My right hip has been hurting for three months.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我真说不上来，医生。
fallbackUnknown.en: That I couldn't tell you, doctor.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时她躺在病床上，平静作答；不要表演记录中没有的疼痛动作或情绪。之后的门诊复诊中，她说腿和外阴肿了、排尿困难，并表示不想住院、不愿再化疗——不要替她说出任何理由。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission she lies on the ward bed and answers calmly; do not act out pain or emotions the record does not describe. At the later clinic visit she says her legs and vulva have swollen and passing urine is difficult, and that she does not want to be admitted or have more chemotherapy — give no reasons for either.

description.zh-CN: 病房入院：了解她髋痛和多年肠道疾病的经过，查体，并在护士站调阅既往肠镜和病理。
description.en: Ward admission: take the story of her hip pain and her long bowel illness, examine her and read her earlier colonoscopy and pathology at the station.

description.zh-CN: 调阅近期PET-CT，计划如何明确诊断并取得指导治疗的检测结果。
description.en: Review the recent PET-CT and plan how to confirm the diagnosis and get the results that guide treatment.

description.zh-CN: 住院期间：控制疼痛、处理骨病灶、讨论全身治疗，并在出院前做好交代。
description.en: During the admission: her pain, the bone lesions, the discussion of systemic treatment and what she needs to know before going home.

description.zh-CN: 数月后她再次来到门诊，出现了新的症状。
description.en: Months later she comes back to clinic with new symptoms.

description.zh-CN: 原报告记录的结局；之后的情况未报告。
description.en: The outcome the report records; what followed is not reported.

message.zh-CN: PET-CT报告在下一阶段开放：请先在会诊板上就她髋痛的首要考虑作出判断（决策1）。
message.en: The PET-CT report opens in the next stage: first commit on the case board to your leading concern about her hip pain (decision 1).

message.zh-CN: 诊断记录在住院治疗阶段开放：请先在会诊板上作答决策2和决策3。
message.en: The recorded diagnosis opens in the inpatient-care stage: first answer decisions 2 and 3 on the case board.

message.zh-CN: 住院治疗记录在数月后复诊阶段开放：请先作答决策4并完成住院期间的处理。
message.en: The inpatient treatment record opens at the later visit: first answer decision 4 and complete her inpatient care.

message.zh-CN: 随访记录在最后开放：请先作答决策5，并完成那次复诊。
message.en: The follow-up record opens at the end: first answer decision 5 and complete that visit.

name.zh-CN: 规律镇痛并按疼痛程度调整
name.en: Regular analgesia titrated to her pain

dose.zh-CN: 先做个体化疼痛评估，及时给予规律镇痛，按疼痛程度逐级调整并每日复评（NICE NG234 2023，1.7.1–1.7.3）；具体药物和剂量由开方医生确定。
dose.en: An individualised pain assessment, then prompt regular analgesia stepped up to her pain and reviewed daily (NICE NG234 2023, 1.7.1–1.7.3); the drug and dose are chosen by the prescriber.

response.zh-CN: 已开具规律镇痛，每天评估疼痛。她实际用过的止痛药和剂量没有记录。
response.en: Regular analgesia is charted and her pain will be reviewed daily. The drugs and doses she actually received are not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 转介姑息放疗（疼痛的骨病灶）
name.en: Refer for palliative radiotherapy to the painful bone lesions

dose.zh-CN: 请放疗科评估右髋臼和腰椎（L3、L5）的放疗；无并发症的疼痛性骨转移以单次8 Gy为标准，分割方式由放疗科医生决定。
dose.en: Clinical oncology referral for radiotherapy to the right acetabulum and the lumbar spine (L3, L5); a single 8 Gy fraction is standard for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, with the schedule set by the clinical oncologist.

response.zh-CN: 放疗科医生接受会诊，将为她计划右髋和腰椎的放疗。
response.en: The clinical oncologist accepts the referral and will plan radiotherapy to her right hip and lumbar spine.

name.zh-CN: 用骨改良药物前的口腔检查

dose.zh-CN: 开始骨改良药物前请口腔科检查，必要的有创牙科处理尽量在用药前完成。
dose.en: Dental review before the first dose of a bone-modifying agent, completing any invasive dental work first where feasible.

response.zh-CN: 口腔科将在首剂前为她检查；没有记录口腔检查的结果。
response.en: The dental team will see her before the first dose; no dental findings are recorded.

name.zh-CN: 骨改良药物（唑来膦酸或地舒单抗）

dose.zh-CN: 唑来膦酸4 mg静脉滴注（按肌酐清除率减量）或地舒单抗120 mg皮下注射，每4周一次；同时补充钙和维生素D。须先完成口腔检查并查肾功能和血钙。
dose.en: Zoledronic acid 4 mg IV (reduced for creatinine clearance) or denosumab 120 mg SC, every 4 weeks, with calcium and vitamin D supplements — after a dental assessment, with renal function and calcium checked.

harm.zh-CN: ESMO 2020骨健康指南：开始骨改良药物前先做口腔检查（并尽量完成有创牙科处理）[III, A]，以防颌骨坏死；补充钙和维生素D、维持血钙正常 [I, A]，地舒单抗尤其要防低钙血症；唑来膦酸剂量取决于肾功能。应先检查口腔、血钙和肾功能。
harm.en: ESMO 2020 bone health: a dental evaluation, completing invasive dental work where feasible, before starting a bone-modifying agent [III, A] — osteonecrosis of the jaw — and calcium and vitamin D with serum calcium kept normal [I, A], hypocalcaemia being a particular risk with denosumab; renal function sets the zoledronate dose. Check her teeth, calcium and renal function first.

response.zh-CN: 已开具首剂，并同时补充钙剂和维生素D。
response.en: The first dose is charted, with calcium and vitamin D supplements.

name.zh-CN: 肿瘤内科会诊（全身治疗方案）
name.en: Medical oncology review of systemic treatment

dose.zh-CN: 请肿瘤内科在活检和分子检测结果出来后，与她共同讨论进一步全身治疗。
dose.en: Ask medical oncology to discuss further systemic treatment with her, through shared decision-making, once the biopsy and biomarker results are back.

response.zh-CN: 肿瘤内科医生会在活检和分子检测结果出来后与她讨论全身治疗。
response.en: The oncologist will discuss systemic treatment with her once the biopsy and biomarker results are available.

name.zh-CN: 转介专科姑息治疗团队
name.en: Refer to the specialist palliative care team

dose.zh-CN: 与抗肿瘤治疗同步，请专科姑息治疗团队参与症状控制和照护计划。
dose.en: Specialist palliative care alongside her cancer treatment, for symptoms and care planning.

response.zh-CN: 姑息治疗团队接受转介；没有记录姑息治疗团队的评估。
response.en: The palliative care team accepts the referral; no palliative care review is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 转介临床遗传科（胚系检测与家系咨询）
name.en: Refer to clinical genetics (germline testing and family counselling)

dose.zh-CN: 转介临床遗传科：为她做息肉病相关基因（APC、MUTYH等）的胚系检测，解释结果对姐姐的意义；如时间可能有限，询问是否保存DNA。
dose.en: Clinical genetics referral for germline testing of the polyposis genes (APC, MUTYH and others) and counselling on what a result means for her sister; if time may be short, ask about storing her DNA.

response.zh-CN: 临床遗传科接受转介；没有记录胚系检测结果。
response.en: Clinical genetics accepts the referral; no germline test result is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 交代脊髓压迫警示症状及联系方式
name.en: Explain cord compression warning signs and whom to call

dose.zh-CN: 出院前告知：新出现或加重的背痛、下肢无力或麻木、排尿或排便异常时立即联系团队，并给她联系电话。
dose.en: Before she goes home: new or worsening back pain, leg weakness or numbness, or bladder or bowel trouble mean she calls the team at once — give her the number.

response.zh-CN: 你向她交代这些警示症状，以及一旦出现应立即联系谁。
response.en: You go through the warning signs with her and whom to call at once if they appear.

name.zh-CN: 建议立即住院评估（新出现的水肿和排尿困难）
name.en: Advise urgent admission for the new swelling and urinary difficulty

dose.zh-CN: 说明担心的原因（脊髓或马尾受压、盆腔病变进展、血栓），建议今天住院紧急评估。
dose.en: Explain the concern (cord or cauda equina compression, pelvic progression, a clot) and advise admission today for urgent assessment.

response.zh-CN: 你说明了担心的原因，建议她今天住院紧急评估。她拒绝住院。
response.en: You explain your concern and advise admission today for urgent assessment. She declines to be admitted.

name.zh-CN: 紧急转诊：立即联系MSCC协调员（或值班肿瘤科），24小时内完成全脊柱MRI
name.en: Urgent MSCC referral: contact the MSCC coordinator now for a whole-spine MRI within 24 hours

dose.zh-CN: 按肿瘤急症处理：立即联系MSCC协调员（没有该岗位时联系值班肿瘤科或脊柱团队），申请尽快、一定在24小时内完成全脊柱MRI（NICE NG234 2023，1.3.2、1.5.2）。
dose.en: Treat it as an oncological emergency: contact the MSCC coordinator now (or the on-call oncology or spinal team where there is none) and request an MRI of the whole spine as soon as possible and always within 24 hours (NICE NG234 2023, 1.3.2, 1.5.2).

response.zh-CN: 值班团队接受转诊，将在24小时内安排全脊柱MRI；本病例没有记录MRI是否完成或其结果。
response.en: The on-call team accepts the referral and will arrange a whole-spine MRI within 24 hours; whether it was done, and any result, is not recorded in this case.

name.zh-CN: 地塞米松16 mg口服（疑似脊髓压迫）

dose.zh-CN: 地塞米松16 mg口服，尽快给予；等待手术或放疗期间每日口服16 mg（NICE NG234 2023，1.8.1）。
dose.en: Dexamethasone 16 mg orally as soon as possible, then 16 mg daily while she awaits surgery or radiotherapy (NICE NG234 2023, 1.8.1).

harm.zh-CN: 此时没有记录脊髓或马尾受压的神经症状或体征。NICE NG234（2023）对有MSCC神经症状或体征者给予地塞米松16 mg（1.8.1）；对没有神经症状或体征者，只在疼痛严重或血液系统肿瘤时才考虑激素（1.8.3），她的记录中两者都没有。没有指征时用激素，只带来高血糖、感染、情绪改变等副作用。
harm.en: No neurological symptom or sign of cord or cauda equina compression is recorded at this point. NICE NG234 (2023) gives dexamethasone 16 mg for neurological symptoms or signs of MSCC (1.8.1) and, without them, considers corticosteroids only for severe pain or a haematological malignancy (1.8.3), neither of which is recorded for her. Without an indication a steroid brings only its harms — hyperglycaemia, infection, mood change.

response.zh-CN: 已开具地塞米松16 mg口服。她是否服用没有记录。
response.en: Dexamethasone 16 mg orally is prescribed. Whether she took it is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 评估拒绝住院的决策能力并商定安全计划
name.en: Assess her capacity to refuse admission and agree a safety-net plan

dose.zh-CN: 针对“是否住院”这一决定评估她能否理解、记住、权衡相关信息并表达决定（以英国《2005年精神能力法》第1、3条为例，请遵循当地法律）；了解她的顾虑，商定她能接受的处理（紧急门诊MRI、膀胱扫描、地塞米松、姑息团队），交代何时、如何立即求助，并记录。
dose.en: For this decision, check that she can understand, retain and weigh the information and communicate her choice (Mental Capacity Act 2005, ss1 and 3, as one legal model; follow local law); explore her concerns, agree what she will accept (an urgent outpatient MRI, a bladder scan, dexamethasone, the palliative care team), tell her when and how to get help at once, and document it.

response.zh-CN: 你与她一起梳理这个决定，并记录了谈话。没有记录决策能力评估的结论，也没有记录她拒绝的原因。
response.en: You go through the decision with her and record the discussion. No capacity assessment and no reasons for her refusal are recorded.

name.zh-CN: 向放疗科调取她的放疗总结（实际剂量、分次、照射野）
name.en: Ask the radiotherapy department for her radiotherapy treatment summary (doses, fractions, fields)

dose.zh-CN: 请放疗科提供她既往放疗的治疗总结：每个部位的总剂量、分次数和照射野，以便再次放疗前评估累积剂量（NICE NG234 2023，1.10.10）。
dose.en: Ask the radiotherapy department for her treatment summary — total dose, number of fractions and fields for each site — so that the cumulative dose can be weighed before any further radiotherapy (NICE NG234 2023, 1.10.10).

response.zh-CN: 放疗科已收到请求，将提供她的治疗总结；本病例没有记录放疗科给出的剂量。
response.en: The radiotherapy department has the request and will send her treatment summary; no dose from the department is recorded in this case.

name.zh-CN: CT引导下左肾上腺穿刺活检
name.en: CT-guided biopsy of the left adrenal gland

dose.zh-CN: CT引导下经皮穿刺左肾上腺病灶取组织。
dose.en: Percutaneous CT-guided needle biopsy of the left adrenal lesion.

harm.zh-CN: ESE/ENSAT 2023（R.6.3.5）：只有在已排除嗜铬细胞瘤、影像不能确定为良性、且病理结果会改变处理时才考虑肾上腺活检。本例一条都不满足：没有甲氧基肾上腺素类结果，淋巴结和骨病灶已决定分期，锁骨上淋巴结才是可及的取材目标。误穿未识别的嗜铬细胞瘤可诱发高血压危象。
harm.en: ESE/ENSAT 2023 (R.6.3.5): an adrenal biopsy is considered only when phaeochromocytoma has been excluded, the lesion is not benign on imaging and the histology would change management. None holds: no metanephrine result is recorded, her nodal and bone disease already defines the stage, and the supraclavicular node is the accessible target. Puncturing an unsuspected phaeochromocytoma can cause a hypertensive crisis.

response.zh-CN: 申请已送至介入放射科。

name.zh-CN: 为新症状预约常规门诊随访（4周后）
name.en: Book a routine clinic review in four weeks for the new symptoms

en: see her in a few weeks

dose.en: A routine outpatient appointment in four weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 已知L3、L5转移的患者新出现排尿困难，是脊髓或马尾可能受压的症状。NICE NG234（2023）：按肿瘤急症处理，立即联系MSCC协调员，尽快且一定在24小时内完成MRI；常规门诊预约可能导致永久性截瘫和膀胱功能丧失。
harm.en: New difficulty passing urine in a patient with L3 and L5 metastases is a symptom of possible cord or cauda equina compression. NICE NG234 (2023): treat it as an oncological emergency, contact the MSCC coordinator immediately and get an MRI as soon as possible and always within 24 hours; a routine appointment risks permanent paralysis and loss of bladder function.

response.en: A routine clinic appointment is booked.

name.zh-CN: 利尿剂消肿（呋塞米）

dose.zh-CN: 口服呋塞米消肿，剂量由开方医生确定。
dose.en: Oral furosemide for the swelling, dose set by the prescriber.

harm.zh-CN: 利尿剂只处理表现、不处理原因。活动性肿瘤患者的下肢水肿首先要评估深静脉血栓——NICE NG158（2020，2023更新）：Wells评分（活动性肿瘤计1分）及近端下肢静脉超声——并考虑盆腔淋巴结进展；排尿困难则需要紧急脊柱影像（NICE NG234 2023）。
harm.en: A diuretic treats the sign, not the cause. In active cancer, leg swelling first needs a DVT assessment — NICE NG158 (2020, updated 2023): a Wells score, in which active cancer scores a point, and a proximal leg vein ultrasound — and pelvic nodal progression considered; the urinary difficulty needs urgent spinal imaging (NICE NG234 2023).

name.zh-CN: 违背其意愿强制收住院

dose.zh-CN: 不顾她的拒绝安排住院和检查。
dose.en: Arrange admission and investigation despite her refusal.

harm.zh-CN: 成年人应被推定具有决策能力，不能仅因决定不明智就认定其缺乏能力（以英国《2005年精神能力法》第1条为例；请遵循当地法律）。违背有决策能力者的拒绝强行收住院不是合法的医疗；应针对这一决定评估能力，并提供她愿意接受的替代方案。
harm.en: An adult is presumed to have capacity and is not to be treated as lacking it merely because a decision is unwise (Mental Capacity Act 2005, s1, as one legal model; follow local law). Admitting her against a capacitous refusal is not lawful care; assess her capacity for this decision and offer the alternatives she will accept.

response.zh-CN: 违背她的意愿安排了住院。
response.en: Admission is arranged against her stated wishes.

name.zh-CN: 结束肿瘤科随访

dose.zh-CN: 因她拒绝治疗而结束肿瘤科随访。
dose.en: Close her oncology follow-up because she has declined treatment.

harm.zh-CN: 拒绝化疗或住院不等于拒绝医疗照护：ASCO 2024建议晚期实体瘤患者在抗肿瘤治疗的同时尽早接受专科姑息治疗；NICE NG234（2023）要求脊柱转移患者在症状变化时知道该联系谁。结束随访会让这两点都落空。
harm.en: Declining chemotherapy or admission is not declining care: ASCO 2024 recommends early specialist palliative care for advanced solid tumours alongside cancer treatment, and NICE NG234 (2023) asks that people with spinal metastases know whom to contact if their symptoms change. Closing her follow-up removes both.

response.zh-CN: 已结束她的肿瘤科随访。

hint.zh-CN: 先问她因何住院、疼了多久；再回顾这些年肠道症状的经过、手术和化疗，以及家里人有没有做过检查。
hint.en: Ask what brought her in and since when; then go back over her bowel symptoms through the years, the operation and the chemotherapy, and whether anyone in her family has been checked.

guidance.en: Talk with her at the bedside.

title.en: Examine her and read her earlier records

hint.zh-CN: 摸颈部和锁骨上淋巴结，检查腹部、右髋、腰椎和下肢；然后在病房电脑上调阅她的肠镜和病理报告。
hint.en: Feel for nodes in the neck and above the collarbones, examine the abdomen, the right hip, the lumbar spine and the legs; then read her colonoscopy and pathology reports on the ward computer.

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁查体，然后到护士站调阅记录。
guidance.en: Examine her at the bedside, then read the records at the station.

title.zh-CN: 解读她的疼痛和家族情况
title.en: Make sense of her pain and her family history

hint.zh-CN: 哪些发现让单纯的肌肉骨骼原因变得不太可能？家人肠镜正常，能说明什么、不能说明什么？
hint.en: Which findings make a simple musculoskeletal cause unlikely? And what can — and cannot — her family's normal colonoscopies tell you?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答第1、2项决策，并安排相应的会诊。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and make the referral that follows.

hint.zh-CN: 读PET-CT报告。哪个病灶最容易、最安全取材？进针前要先查什么？肾上腺的发现需要怎样处理？
hint.en: Read the PET-CT report. Which lesion is easiest and safest to sample, what should be checked before a needle goes in, and what does the adrenal finding need?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅PET-CT，开具检查，然后作答第3项决策。
guidance.en: Read the PET-CT at the station, order the tests, then answer decision 3.

title.en: Treat her pain and plan her care

hint.zh-CN: 什么最能缓解骨痛？什么影像检查能指导局部治疗？保护骨骼的药物用前要查什么？还应请谁参与？她出院前需要知道什么？
hint.en: What relieves bone pain best, which imaging guides the local treatment, what must be checked before a drug that protects the skeleton, who else should be involved, and what does she need to know before she goes home?

guidance.zh-CN: 开具检查、治疗和会诊，然后作答第4项决策。
guidance.en: Order the imaging, give the treatments and referrals, then answer decision 4.

title.en: See her again when things change

hint.zh-CN: 新出现的排尿困难和水肿可能是什么原因？要多快查清？再次放疗之前，她的治疗记录里有什么必须先核实？她说“不”的时候你该怎么做？最后调阅随访记录。
hint.en: What could explain new trouble passing urine and the swelling, and how quickly must it be investigated? What in her treatment record must be checked before any further radiotherapy? What do you do when she says no? Then read the follow-up record.

guidance.zh-CN: 在门诊与她交谈，调阅住院治疗记录，安排紧急转诊、检查和处理，作答第5项决策，再调阅随访记录。
guidance.en: Talk with her in clinic, read her inpatient treatment record, make the urgent referral and give what is needed, answer decision 5, then read the follow-up record.

prompt.zh-CN: 她因淋巴结阳性的直肠癌行直肠及全结肠切除，术后FOLFOX6化疗12次，现右髋疼痛3个月。查体：左锁骨上约1 cm质硬、活动差的淋巴结，右髋及腰椎轻压痛。你最担心什么？首先怎么做？
prompt.en: After a rectal and total colonic resection and 12 cycles of FOLFOX6 for a node-positive rectal cancer, she has had right hip pain for three months. On examination there is a hard, poorly mobile node of about 1 cm in the left supraclavicular fossa and mild right hip and lumbar tenderness. What is your leading concern, and what do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清髋痛和肿瘤治疗经过，完成查体，并调阅既往病理。
need.en: First take the history of the hip pain and her cancer treatment, examine her, and read her earlier pathology.

text.zh-CN: 首先考虑转移复发：调阅她近期的PET-CT，找出可以安全取材的病灶，并明确病变累及的范围
text.en: Metastatic recurrence until proven otherwise: review her recent PET-CT, look for a lesion that can be sampled safely, and stage how far the disease has spread

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。肿瘤治疗后新出现、持续的骨痛，首先要排除复发转移；左锁骨上质硬、活动差的淋巴结（Virchow淋巴结）和腰椎压痛指向同一方向。她已做过的PET-CT正是此刻要看的分期检查；接下来的计划取决于能否从最容易取材的部位取得组织证实——影像本身给不出肿瘤的分子标志物。
feedback.en: Right. New, persistent bone pain after cancer treatment means recurrence must be excluded first, and a hard, poorly mobile left supraclavicular node (Virchow's node) and lumbar tenderness point the same way. The PET-CT she has already had is the staging study to read now; what follows hinges on tissue confirmation from the most accessible site — imaging alone does not give the tumour's biomarkers.

text.zh-CN: 年轻人髋关节的机械性疼痛：现在先规律止痛加理疗，6周后仍未缓解再安排影像学检查
text.en: A mechanical hip problem in a young adult: regular analgesia and physiotherapy now, with imaging only if the pain has not settled after six weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。对健康年轻人的机械性疼痛，先止痛、理疗观察6周是合理的；但她有淋巴结阳性直肠癌病史，又有质硬的锁骨上淋巴结，这些危险信号要求现在就明确分期，而不是先试验性治疗。NICE NG234（2023）把既往癌症病史合并局部脊柱压痛列为提示脊柱转移的表现。
feedback.en: No. Analgesia and physiotherapy for six weeks suits mechanical pain in a healthy young adult, but she has had a node-positive rectal cancer and now has a hard supraclavicular node — red flags that call for staging now, not a trial of treatment. NICE NG234 (2023) lists a past diagnosis of cancer with localised spinal tenderness among the features suggesting spinal metastases.

text.zh-CN: 化疗后股骨头缺血性坏死：下一步做右髋MRI并请骨科会诊，暂不做其他部位的检查
text.en: Avascular necrosis of the femoral head after chemotherapy: a right hip MRI and an orthopaedic opinion as the next step, without imaging anywhere else

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。年轻人髋痛时股骨头坏死值得考虑，但它解释不了质硬的锁骨上淋巴结和腰椎压痛，只做右髋MRI会漏掉其余病灶。应先做全身分期——她已经做过PET-CT。
feedback.en: No. Avascular necrosis is worth remembering in a young adult with hip pain, but it does not explain a hard supraclavicular node or lumbar tenderness, and a hip MRI alone would miss the rest of the picture. Stage the whole body first — she already has a PET-CT.

text.zh-CN: 腰椎牵涉痛合并反应性颈部淋巴结：复查CEA、对症止痛，3个月后门诊再评估
text.en: Referred pain from the lumbar spine with a reactive neck node: repeat the CEA, give analgesia and review her in clinic in three months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。结直肠癌治疗后出现质硬、活动差的锁骨上淋巴结，在取材证实前应按恶性对待，而不是当作反应性增生；CEA在复发时也可以正常，等3个月会让有症状的病变一直得不到分期。
feedback.en: No. A hard, poorly mobile supraclavicular node after colorectal cancer is presumed malignant until sampled, not reactive; and the CEA can be normal despite recurrence, so a three-month wait would leave symptomatic disease unstaged.

prompt.zh-CN: 她的病理显示全结肠多发息肉（管状腺瘤及绒毛管状腺瘤），直肠癌在30岁之前确诊；父母和姐姐做过肠镜，没有发现明显异常。关于遗传方面你怎么处理？
prompt.en: Her pathology showed multiple polyps throughout the colon — tubular and tubulovillous adenomas — with a rectal cancer diagnosed before she was 30. Her parents and older sister have had colonoscopies with nothing obvious found. What do you do about the hereditary question?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅既往病理，并问清她的肠道病史和家族史。
need.en: First read her earlier pathology and ask about her bowel history and her family.

text.zh-CN: 现在就转介临床遗传科，先为她做胚系检测（APC、MUTYH及息肉病基因组合），找到家族变异后再为姐姐做预测性检测
text.en: Refer her to clinical genetics for germline testing now — APC, MUTYH and a polyposis gene panel — and offer her sister predictive testing once a family variant is found

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020指南（表2）把30岁及以下确诊的结直肠癌列为胚系多基因检测的指征，并建议为多发腺瘤者（60岁前累计≥10枚）检测——她的息肉数量没有记录，但病理为多发腺瘤。应先检测患者本人：找到她的致病变异，亲属才能做有意义的预测性检测。APC（显性遗传）和MUTYH（隐性遗传）都能引起腺瘤性息肉病，对家人的意义不同。家族变异明确前，该指南建议临床诊断为FAP者的一级亲属从12–14岁起每5年做一次肠镜，直到出现息肉病表型或到达参加国家筛查的年龄（50岁仍无表型则FAP可能性不大）——姐姐一次肠镜正常不能解除随访。若她的时间可能有限，可询问是否保存她的DNA。
feedback.en: Right. BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020 (Table 2) lists colorectal cancer diagnosed at 30 or younger as an indication for germline panel testing, and suggests testing people with multiple adenomas (a lifetime total of 10 or more before 60) — her polyp count is not recorded, but the pathology shows multiple adenomas. Test the affected person first: finding her variant is what makes predictive testing of relatives meaningful. APC (dominant) and MUTYH (recessive) both cause adenomatous polyposis, with different implications for the family. Until a family variant is known, the guideline suggests colonoscopy every 5 years from 12–14 for first-degree relatives of someone with clinical FAP, until polyposis appears or they reach national screening age (FAP is unlikely if no phenotype by 50) — one normal colonoscopy does not discharge her sister. If time may be short, ask about storing her DNA.

text.zh-CN: 无需遗传咨询：父母和姐姐的肠镜都正常，说明这个家庭存在遗传性息肉病综合征的可能性很小，她的肠癌按散发性肠癌处理即可
text.en: No genetics referral: normal colonoscopies in both her parents and her older sister make an inherited polyposis syndrome very unlikely, so her cancer can be treated as sporadic

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。阴性家族史不能排除息肉病：15%–30%的APC致病变异为新发变异，父母可以都不受累，合子后发生的变异还会形成嵌合（EHTG–ESCP 2024欧洲FAP/MAP指南）；MUTYH相关息肉病为隐性遗传，携带者父母通常不发病（BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020）。姐姐一次肠镜正常也不能排除她携带变异，更不能据此把她的肠癌当作散发性。
feedback.en: No. A negative family history does not exclude polyposis: 15–30% of APC pathogenic variants arise de novo, so neither parent need be affected, and post-zygotic variants cause mosaicism (EHTG–ESCP 2024 European FAP/MAP guideline); MUTYH-associated polyposis is recessive, so carrier parents are usually unaffected (BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020). One normal colonoscopy in her sister does not exclude a variant either, and nothing here makes her cancer sporadic.

text.zh-CN: 先给父母和姐姐查APC变异，只有其中有人携带变异时，再转介她本人做遗传咨询和检测
text.en: Test her parents and her sister for APC variants first, and refer her for genetic counselling only if one of them turns out to carry a variant

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，顺序反了。在家族变异未知时检测未患病的亲属意义不大：阴性结果并不能让她们放心。应先检测患者本人；明确她的变异后，姐姐再做预测性检测，据此决定解除随访还是继续监测。
feedback.en: No — the order is reversed. Testing unaffected relatives before a family variant is known is uninformative: a negative result cannot reassure them. Test the affected person first; once her variant is known, her sister can have predictive testing and be either released from or kept in surveillance.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭病理就诊断家族性腺瘤性息肉病：表型已经这么明确，胚系检测对她本人和家人都没有额外意义
text.en: Record familial adenomatous polyposis from the histology alone: once the phenotype is this clear, a germline test adds nothing for her or her family

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。表型只能给出临床诊断；只有胚系检测才能区分APC相关息肉病与MUTYH相关息肉病——显性还是隐性遗传、对姐姐和子女的风险都不同——并使亲属的预测性检测成为可能。
feedback.en: No. The phenotype gives a clinical diagnosis, but only germline testing tells APC-related polyposis from MUTYH-associated polyposis — dominant or recessive inheritance, with different risks for her sister and any children — and makes predictive testing of relatives possible.

text.zh-CN: 先处理眼前的问题，遗传咨询以后再说：胚系结果现在不会改变她本人的治疗，可以先放一放
text.en: Deal with the current problem first and leave genetics for later: a germline result will not change her own treatment now, so it can safely wait

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胚系结果现在就有意义：它决定姐姐的风险和筛查方案，指导APC携带者的结肠外监测；而且检测患者本人比日后检测亲属有价值得多。只要对她剩余的时间有任何疑虑，拖延就可能永远失去检测她的机会。
feedback.en: No. A germline result matters now: it defines her sister's risk and screening and guides extracolonic surveillance in an APC carrier, and testing the affected person is far more informative than testing relatives later. If there is any doubt about how much time she has, waiting risks losing the chance to test her at all.

prompt.zh-CN: PET-CT报告：盆壁、腹膜后及左锁骨上淋巴结，右髋臼、L3及L5异常摄取，考虑转移；左肾上腺饱满，不除外转移。你如何确诊并明确病变的性质？
prompt.en: The PET-CT reports abnormal uptake in pelvic-wall, retroperitoneal and left supraclavicular lymph nodes, the right acetabulum, L3 and L5, considered metastases; the left adrenal gland is bulky and metastasis is not excluded. How do you confirm and characterise her disease?

text.zh-CN: 查血常规和凝血后，超声引导下穿刺左锁骨上淋巴结取组织，做MMR、RAS、BRAF检测；肾上腺先查甲氧基肾上腺素类
text.en: Ultrasound-guided core biopsy of the left supraclavicular node once a blood count and clotting are checked, with MMR, RAS and BRAF testing; metanephrines for the adrenal

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。从最容易取材的病灶取组织——可触及的锁骨上淋巴结，超声引导下穿刺——先查血小板和凝血。它能证实复发（并排除第二原发癌）；转移灶组织是治疗预测性生物标志物检测的首选标本，没有时原发灶组织也可接受（ASCP/CAP/AMP/ASCO 2017）；MMR状态、RAS和BRAF决定全身治疗方案。肾上腺方面，ESE/ENSAT 2023建议对有肾上腺外恶性肿瘤、肾上腺病灶性质不明者测定甲氧基肾上腺素类以排除嗜铬细胞瘤（R.6.3.1），病灶性质不会改变处理时以影像随访代替活检（R.6.3.4）。
feedback.en: Right. Take tissue from the most accessible lesion — the palpable supraclavicular node, under ultrasound — after checking platelets and clotting. It confirms recurrence (and excludes a second cancer), and metastatic tissue is the preferred specimen for treatment-predictive biomarkers, with the primary acceptable when it is not available (ASCP/CAP/AMP/ASCO 2017); MMR status, RAS and BRAF guide systemic treatment. For the adrenal, ESE/ENSAT 2023 recommends metanephrines to exclude phaeochromocytoma in a patient with an extra-adrenal cancer and an indeterminate adrenal lesion (R.6.3.1), and imaging follow-up rather than biopsy when its nature would not change management (R.6.3.4).

text.zh-CN: 先行CT引导下左肾上腺穿刺活检，因为证实这个性质不明的肾上腺病灶为恶性，会改变她的分期和治疗方案
text.en: CT-guided biopsy of the left adrenal gland first, because showing that the indeterminate adrenal lesion is malignant would change her stage and her treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，而且不安全。ESE/ENSAT 2023（R.6.3.5）只有在已排除嗜铬细胞瘤、影像不能确定为良性、且病理结果会改变处理时才考虑肾上腺活检，本例一条都不满足：淋巴结和骨病灶已经决定了分期，锁骨上淋巴结更容易取材；而且家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者肾上腺肿块的发生率是一般人群的2–3倍（EHTG–ESCP 2024），“饱满”的肾上腺未必是转移。误穿未识别的嗜铬细胞瘤可诱发高血压危象。
feedback.en: No — and unsafe. ESE/ENSAT 2023 (R.6.3.5) considers adrenal biopsy only when phaeochromocytoma has been excluded, the lesion is not benign on imaging and the histology would change management; none is met here. Her nodal and bone lesions already define the stage and the supraclavicular node is far easier to reach; and adrenal masses are 2–3 times more common in familial adenomatous polyposis than in the general population (EHTG–ESCP 2024), so a 'bulky' adrenal is not necessarily metastatic. Puncturing an unsuspected phaeochromocytoma can trigger a hypertensive crisis.

text.zh-CN: 无需活检：淋巴结阳性直肠癌术后出现这种PET-CT表现即可诊断，立即开始二线化疗，以后再把原手术标本送去做RAS和BRAF检测
text.en: No biopsy: after a node-positive rectal cancer this PET-CT pattern is diagnostic, so start second-line chemotherapy now and send the old resection specimen for RAS and BRAF testing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这种表现高度提示转移，但选择全身治疗前应先明确MMR状态、RAS和BRAF；而且具有息肉病表现的年轻女性也可能是第二原发肿瘤。淋巴结容易取材，代价小而且会改变方案；原手术标本可以作为生物标志物检测的备选，但不是省去复发病理证实的理由。
feedback.en: No. The pattern is highly suggestive, but MMR status, RAS and BRAF should be known before choosing systemic treatment, and a young woman with a polyposis phenotype can have a second malignancy. With an accessible node, tissue costs little and changes the plan; the archival primary is an acceptable fallback for biomarkers, not a reason to skip confirming the recurrence.

text.zh-CN: CT引导下穿刺右髋臼病灶，因为疼痛来自骨，这里取到的标本最能解释她的症状和病情
text.en: CT-guided biopsy of the right acetabular lesion, since bone is where her pain comes from and a sample there would best explain her symptoms

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。骨活检比淋巴结活检创伤大，骨标本通常需要脱钙，酸性脱钙会影响RAS、BRAF和MSI等分子检测。可触及的淋巴结能更安全地给出同样的诊断，而且组织更适合做生物标志物检测。
feedback.en: No. A bone biopsy is more invasive than a node biopsy, and the decalcification bone samples usually need — acid decalcification in particular — can compromise molecular tests such as RAS, BRAF and MSI. The palpable node gives the same diagnosis more safely, with better tissue for biomarkers.

text.zh-CN: 每月复查CEA，3个月后复查PET-CT，到时病灶增大了再考虑取材或治疗
text.en: Track the CEA every month and repeat the PET-CT in three months, and only sample or treat the lesions if they are growing by then

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她现在就有症状性转移——负重关节和腰椎疼痛——而且有可以取材的淋巴结。等3个月看病灶是否增大，会推迟诊断以及依赖诊断的放疗和全身治疗决策。
feedback.en: No. She has symptomatic metastatic disease now — pain in a weight-bearing joint and the lumbar spine — and a reachable node. Waiting three months for growth delays the diagnosis and the radiotherapy and systemic decisions that depend on it.

prompt.zh-CN: 右髋臼、L3、L5报告为转移，她右髋疼痛，入院时右髋和腰椎有轻压痛。住院期间你对骨转移怎样处理？
prompt.en: The right acetabulum, L3 and L5 are reported as metastases; she has right hip pain, with mild right hip and lumbar tenderness on admission. What is your plan for her bone disease during this admission?

need.zh-CN: 先完成确诊方案和遗传问题两项决策。
need.en: First answer the diagnostic-plan and hereditary decisions.

text.zh-CN: 规律止痛，对疼痛部位放疗（无并发症时单次8 Gy），口腔检查后用骨改良药物，并交代脊髓压迫的警示症状
text.en: Regular analgesia, radiotherapy to the painful sites (a single 8 Gy fraction if uncomplicated), a bone-modifying agent after a dental check, and cord compression warning signs

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESMO 2020骨健康指南：外照射放疗是局限性中重度骨痛的首选治疗，疼痛性、无并发症的骨转移推荐单次8 Gy [I, A]；对有临床意义骨转移、预计生存≥3个月的实体瘤患者推荐唑来膦酸或地舒单抗 [I, B]，用药前先做口腔检查 [III, A]，并补充钙和维生素D [I, A]。NICE NG234（2023）对无脊髓压迫、表现为非机械性疼痛的脊柱转移给予单次8 Gy放疗（1.10.2），建议1周内做MRI以指导治疗（1.5.3），并要求让脊柱转移患者知道出现新症状时该联系谁（1.2.2）。
feedback.en: Right. ESMO 2020 bone health: external beam radiotherapy is the treatment of choice for localised moderate-to-severe bone pain, and a single 8 Gy fraction is recommended for painful uncomplicated bone metastases [I, A]; zoledronate or denosumab for solid tumours with clinically significant bone metastases and a life expectancy of at least 3 months [I, B], after a dental evaluation [III, A] and with calcium and vitamin D [I, A]. NICE NG234 (2023) offers single-fraction 8 Gy for spinal metastases without cord compression causing non-mechanical pain (1.10.2), an MRI within a week to guide treatment (1.5.3), and asks that people with spinal metastases know whom to contact if new symptoms appear (1.2.2).

text.zh-CN: 暂时只用骨改良药物，放疗留作后备，等药物治疗3个月后疼痛仍不缓解再考虑放疗
text.en: A bone-modifying agent on its own for now, keeping radiotherapy in reserve until the pain has failed to respond to the drug over three months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。骨改良药物在数月内减少骨相关事件，并不是控制已有疼痛的手段。ESMO 2020把放疗作为局限性中重度骨痛的首选治疗；把放疗留作后备，会让疼痛的负重关节和两个腰椎病灶得不到治疗。
feedback.en: No. Bone-modifying agents reduce skeletal events over months; they are not the treatment for established pain. ESMO 2020 makes radiotherapy the treatment of choice for localised moderate-to-severe bone pain, and holding it back leaves a painful weight-bearing joint and two lumbar vertebrae untreated.

text.zh-CN: 先对所有PET阳性部位（包括淋巴结和肾上腺）行长程放疗，30 Gy/10次或更高剂量，再考虑其他治疗
text.en: Long-course radiotherapy, 30 Gy in 10 fractions or more, to every PET-avid site including the nodes and the adrenal, before any other treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。对疼痛性、无并发症的骨转移，单次8 Gy与多次分割的止痛效果相同（ESMO 2020；NICE NG234 2023）；放疗针对有症状的部位而不是所有PET阳性病灶，长程分割留给需要局部控制等特定情况。照射无症状淋巴结和性质未定的肾上腺只增加毒性，没有获益。
feedback.en: No. For painful uncomplicated bone metastases a single 8 Gy fraction controls pain as well as longer courses (ESMO 2020; NICE NG234 2023); radiotherapy is aimed at symptomatic sites, not every PET-avid lesion, with longer schedules kept for situations such as local control. Irradiating asymptomatic nodes and an indeterminate adrenal adds toxicity without benefit.

text.zh-CN: 先行预防性右髋臼重建手术，放疗和骨改良药物都推迟到她术后恢复、伤口愈合以后再做，以免影响切口和骨质的愈合
text.en: Prophylactic surgical reconstruction of the right acetabulum first, with radiotherapy and bone-modifying treatment deferred until she has recovered from the operation and the wound has healed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。病理性骨折或即将骨折时，经骨科评估后可以手术；但没有任何记录显示骨折，为大手术推迟放疗和骨保护，会延误眼下能止痛的治疗。若担心骨折风险，可在计划放疗的同时请骨科评估。
feedback.en: No. Surgery has a place for a pathological or impending fracture after orthopaedic assessment, but nothing recorded shows a fracture, and deferring radiotherapy and bone protection for a major operation delays the treatment that relieves pain now. If fracture risk is a concern, ask the orthopaedic surgeons while radiotherapy is planned.

text.zh-CN: 单用强阿片类药物、不做局部治疗，因为她一旦同意化疗，全身治疗自然会控制骨转移
text.en: Strong opioids alone with no local treatment, because systemic chemotherapy will treat the bone metastases once she agrees to start it

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。止痛药应该用，但全身治疗不能替代对疼痛性骨转移的局部放疗——何况她可能拒绝化疗。现在就局部治疗疼痛；全身治疗要在生物标志物结果出来后与她另行商定。
feedback.en: No. Analgesia belongs in the plan, but systemic treatment does not replace local radiotherapy for painful bone metastases — and she may decline it. Treat the pain locally now; the systemic decision is made separately, with her, once the biomarkers are known.

prompt.zh-CN: 数月后她来到门诊：下肢和外阴水肿、排尿困难，并表示不想住院。她的PET-CT曾显示L3、L5以及盆壁、腹膜后淋巴结病变。你怎么处理？
prompt.en: Months later she comes to clinic with swelling of the lower limbs and vulva and difficulty passing urine, and says she does not want to be admitted. Her PET-CT showed disease at L3 and L5 and in pelvic-wall and retroperitoneal nodes. What do you do?

need.zh-CN: 先问清她这次的新症状，以及她是否愿意住院。
need.en: First ask what has changed and whether she would come into hospital.

text.zh-CN: 考虑脊髓或马尾受压：建议住院，24小时内做全脊柱MRI；她若仍拒绝，评估决策能力，商定她能接受的处理并交代返诊指征
text.en: Possible cord or cauda equina compression: advise admission for a whole-spine MRI within 24 hours; if she still declines, check capacity, agree what she accepts and safety-net

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。有肿瘤病史、已知L3和L5转移的患者出现排尿障碍，是脊髓或马尾可能受压的症状：NICE NG234（2023）将其视为肿瘤急症——立即联系MSCC协调员（1.3.2），尽快且一定在24小时内完成MRI（1.5.2），有神经症状或体征时给予地塞米松16 mg（1.8.1）。下肢和外阴水肿还要考虑盆腔病变进展和静脉血栓（NICE NG158：Wells评估，活动性肿瘤计1分；近端下肢静脉超声）。成年人应被推定具有决策能力，即使决定不明智也有权拒绝（以英国《2005年精神能力法》第1、3条为例）；针对这一决定评估她的能力，了解原因，提供她愿意接受的处理，并确保她知道该找谁。
feedback.en: Right. Bladder dysfunction in someone with cancer and known L3 and L5 metastases is a symptom of possible cord or cauda equina compression: NICE NG234 (2023) treats it as an oncological emergency — contact the MSCC coordinator immediately (1.3.2), MRI as soon as possible and always within 24 hours (1.5.2), and dexamethasone 16 mg for neurological symptoms or signs (1.8.1). Leg and vulval swelling also need pelvic progression and venous thrombosis considered (NICE NG158: a Wells assessment, in which active cancer scores a point, and a proximal leg vein ultrasound). An adult is presumed to have capacity and may refuse even unwisely (Mental Capacity Act 2005, ss1 and 3, as one legal model); check capacity for this decision, explore her reasons, offer what she will accept and make sure she knows whom to call.

text.zh-CN: 盆腔淋巴结所致的淋巴水肿：现在给予弹力袜和利尿剂，常规门诊随访，并预约几周后的腰椎MRI
text.en: Lymphoedema from her pelvic nodes: compression stockings and a diuretic now, with a routine clinic review and a lumbar MRI booked for the next few weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。水肿可能是淋巴性的，但排尿困难不能用它解释：她有腰椎转移，必须按脊髓或马尾可能受压处理，NICE NG234（2023）要求24小时内而不是几周后完成MRI。活动性肿瘤患者的下肢水肿，在用弹力袜或利尿剂之前还要先排除深静脉血栓（NICE NG158）。
feedback.en: No. The swelling may be lymphatic, but the difficulty passing urine cannot be put down to it: with lumbar metastases it must be treated as possible cord or cauda equina compression, and NICE NG234 (2023) asks for MRI within 24 hours, not weeks. Leg swelling in active cancer also needs a DVT excluded before compression or a diuretic (NICE NG158).

text.zh-CN: 不管她是否拒绝都收住院：截瘫的风险太高，不能接受她的决定，即使她反对也要安排住院和MRI
text.en: Admit her regardless of her refusal: the risk of paralysis is too high to accept her decision, so arrange the admission and the MRI even if she objects

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。风险确实存在，但成年人应被推定具有决策能力，不能仅因决定不明智就认定其缺乏能力（以英国《2005年精神能力法》第1条为例；请遵循当地法律）。针对这一决定评估她的能力；若她有能力，尊重她的拒绝，同时提供她愿意接受的一切替代方案——紧急门诊MRI、地塞米松、膀胱扫描——并交代返诊指征。
feedback.en: No. The risk is real, but an adult is presumed to have capacity and is not to be treated as lacking it merely because her decision is unwise (Mental Capacity Act 2005, s1, as one legal model; follow local law). Assess her capacity for this decision; if she has it, respect the refusal while offering every alternative she will accept — an urgent outpatient MRI, dexamethasone, a bladder scan — and safety-netting.

text.zh-CN: 尊重她的意愿，结束肿瘤科随访：她已经拒绝了化疗和住院，再向她提出任何检查或治疗方案，都只会违背她本人已经清楚表明的选择
text.en: Respect her wishes and close her oncology follow-up: she has declined both chemotherapy and admission, so offering any further tests or plans would only go against the choices she has stated

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。拒绝化疗或住院不等于拒绝医疗照护。ASCO 2024建议晚期实体瘤患者在抗肿瘤治疗的同时尽早接受专科姑息治疗；NICE NG234（2023）要求脊柱转移患者始终知道该联系谁。保持沟通渠道，提供姑息治疗和症状控制，并安排她愿意接受的处理。
feedback.en: No. Declining chemotherapy or admission is not declining care. ASCO 2024 recommends early specialist palliative care alongside cancer treatment for advanced solid tumours, and NICE NG234 (2023) asks that people with spinal metastases always know whom to contact; keep the door open, offer palliative care and symptom control, and arrange what she will accept.

text.zh-CN: 尿路感染合并体位性水肿：查尿常规，开始抗生素治疗，嘱抬高下肢，两周后再来复诊
text.en: A urinary infection with dependent oedema: send a urine dipstick, start antibiotics, advise leg elevation and review her again in two weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有任何记录提示感染；两周后复诊会错过可能的脊髓或马尾受压——NICE NG234（2023）要求24小时内完成MRI——也会漏掉导致水肿的盆腔病变进展或静脉血栓。
feedback.en: No. Nothing recorded points to infection, and a two-week review would miss possible cord or cauda equina compression — NICE NG234 (2023) asks for MRI within 24 hours — as well as pelvic progression or a venous thrombosis behind the swelling.

text.zh-CN: 问清髋痛经过、青春期以来的肠道病史、手术和化疗，以及家人做肠镜的情况
text.en: Took the history of the hip pain, the bowel illness since adolescence, the operation, the chemotherapy and the family's colonoscopies

text.zh-CN: 检查锁骨上区、腹部和造口、右髋、腰椎及下肢
text.en: Examined the supraclavicular fossae, the abdomen and stoma, the right hip, the lumbar spine and the legs

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把她的髋痛当作需要分期并取材证实的复发来处理
text.en: At the first attempt, treated her hip pain as a recurrence to be staged and confirmed in tissue
Read the earlier pathology and the PET-CT report

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择先为患者本人做胚系检测，并转介临床遗传科
text.en: Chose germline testing of the patient herself first, at the first attempt, and referred her to clinical genetics

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择可及的淋巴结取材，并开具血常规、凝血、淋巴结穿刺、肿瘤分子检测和甲氧基肾上腺素类
text.en: Chose the accessible node for tissue at the first attempt, and ordered the blood count, clotting, node biopsy, tumour biomarkers and metanephrines

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择以放疗为主的骨转移处理；住院期间给予止痛、申请脊柱MRI、转介放疗，并在口腔检查和抽血之后才开始骨保护
text.en: Chose radiotherapy-led bone care at the first attempt; during the admission gave analgesia, requested a spine MRI, referred for radiotherapy, and started bone protection only after the dental check and bloods

text.zh-CN: 转介专科姑息治疗、请肿瘤内科会诊，并在出院前交代脊髓压迫警示症状
text.en: Involved specialist palliative care and medical oncology, and explained the cord compression warning signs before discharge

text.zh-CN: 复诊当次即建议紧急住院，并立即转诊、申请24小时内的全脊柱MRI
text.en: At the later visit itself, advised urgent admission and made the urgent referral for a whole-spine MRI within 24 hours

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确处理她的拒绝：评估决策能力、给予地塞米松并商定安全计划
text.en: Handled her refusal well at the first attempt: capacity checked, dexamethasone given and a safety-net plan agreed

text.zh-CN: 未造成伤害：未做肾上腺穿刺、新症状未按常规门诊延误、未用利尿剂消肿、未强制住院、未结束对她的照护，也未在没有指征时用激素
text.en: Avoided harm: no adrenal biopsy, no routine appointment for the new symptoms, no diuretic for the swelling, no compulsory admission, no ending of her care and no steroid without an indication

text.zh-CN: 复诊时调阅住院治疗记录，并在任何再次放疗之前向放疗科核实她实际接受的剂量
text.en: At the later visit, read the inpatient treatment record and asked the radiotherapy department for the doses she actually received before any further radiotherapy

text.zh-CN: 调阅数月后的随访记录
text.en: Read the follow-up record from months later

text.zh-CN: 与她沟通复发的消息、检查的意义、对家人的影响，以及她拒绝住院时的选择
text.en: Talked with her about the recurrence, what the tests are for, what it means for her family, and her choices when she declined admission

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：按SPIKES告知PET-CT显示肿瘤已转移到淋巴结和骨——先了解她已知道什么、想知道多少，用通俗的话说明，回应她的情绪；解释为什么要做活检和基因检测、胚系结果对她姐姐意味着什么、脊髓压迫有哪些警示症状，并用“回授法”确认她听懂；复诊时先了解（而不是反驳）她不愿住院的原因，诚实说明截瘫和膀胱功能受损的风险，商定她能接受的处理和求助方式，并明确告诉她拒绝治疗不等于结束照护。不说出记录中没有的预后或理由。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: uses SPIKES to share that the PET-CT shows spread to lymph nodes and bone — finds out what she already knows and wants to know, gives the news in plain words and responds to her emotion; explains why a biopsy and gene tests matter, what a germline result would mean for her sister, and the warning signs of spinal cord compression, checking understanding by teach-back; at the later visit explores (rather than argues with) her reasons for declining admission, is honest about the risk of paralysis and bladder damage, agrees what she will accept and how to get help, and makes clear that declining treatment does not end her care. States no prognosis or reasons that the record does not give.

name.zh-CN: 唐护士（病房）

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交班（ISBAR）：S——29岁女性，右髋疼痛3个月入院。B——既往肠道手术（回肠造口），术后化疗；她的既往肠镜和病理报告在病房护士站电脑上，她说因髋痛最近做过PET-CT。A——入院时的生命体征和化验在你能看到的记录里没有。R——请查看患者并调阅记录。复述医嘱，只报告已有的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到记录中没有的内容（生命体征、化验数值、她用过的药名）时，直接说记录里没有。
knowledge.en: Admission handover (ISBAR): Situation — 29-year-old woman admitted with three months of right hip pain. Background — earlier bowel surgery with an ileostomy, then chemotherapy; her old colonoscopy and pathology reports are on the ward station computer, and she says a PET-CT was done recently for the hip pain. Assessment — her admission observations and blood results are not in the records available to you. Recommendation — please see her and review the records. Reads orders back, reports only results that exist, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not in the record (observations, blood values, the names of drugs she received).

name.zh-CN: 梁医生（肿瘤内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已获得的资料提问，例如：“哪些发现让你不再考虑单纯的肌肉骨骼原因？”“你会从哪个病灶取材？为什么不是肾上腺？”“任何人给肾上腺肿块进针之前，必须先排除什么？”“父母和姐姐肠镜正常，为什么不能回答遗传问题？”“应该先检测谁的DNA？结果对她姐姐有什么影响？”“单次8 Gy与长程放疗相比各有什么特点？”“用骨改良药物前要查什么？”“已知L3、L5转移的女性新出现排尿困难意味着什么？要多快行动？”“有人要给她再次放疗之前，治疗记录里的哪一项必须先核实？”“她说不住院——下一步怎么做？”。可以讲解BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020、EHTG–ESCP 2024、ESE/ENSAT 2023、ESMO 2020骨健康、NICE NG234（2023）和ASCO 2024姑息治疗指南的相关原则。在学员作答前不说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充记录中没有的内容（息肉数量、骨保护药物、真实放疗剂量、她拒绝的原因、生存情况均未记录）。用PEARLS框架复盘。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher who asks only about what the learner has already found, e.g. “Which findings move you away from a simple musculoskeletal cause?”, “Which lesion would you sample, and why not the adrenal?”, “What must be excluded before anyone puts a needle in an adrenal mass?”, “Why do her parents' and sister's normal colonoscopies not settle the hereditary question?”, “Whose DNA should be tested first, and what does a result change for her sister?”, “What does a single 8 Gy fraction offer compared with a longer course?”, “What do you check before a bone-modifying agent?”, “What does new difficulty passing urine mean in a woman with L3 and L5 metastases, and how fast must you act?”, “Before anyone irradiates her again, what in her treatment record must be checked first?”, “She has said no to admission — what is your next step?”. May explain the relevant principles of BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020, EHTG–ESCP 2024, ESE/ENSAT 2023, ESMO 2020 bone health, NICE NG234 (2023) and ASCO 2024 palliative care. Never states the diagnosis or a decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds nothing the record lacks (the number of polyps, the bone-protective drug, the real radiotherapy doses, her reasons for declining and her survival are not recorded). Debriefs with PEARLS.

name.zh-CN: 沈医生（临床遗传科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床遗传科医生。可以解释：胚系检测先检测患者本人（APC、MUTYH及组合内其他息肉病基因）；父母肠镜正常并不能排除APC新发变异或嵌合（EHTG–ESCP 2024：15%–30%为新发），也不能排除隐性遗传的MUTYH相关息肉病；找到家族变异后姐姐可做预测性检测，在此之前，按BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020，临床诊断FAP者的一级亲属从12–14岁起每5年做一次肠镜，直到出现息肉病表型或到达参加国家筛查的年龄；时间可能有限时可保存DNA。知道她没有任何胚系检测结果记录，不编造结果。
knowledge.en: Clinical geneticist. Explains testing the affected person first (APC, MUTYH and the other polyposis genes on a panel); why normal colonoscopies in her parents exclude neither a de novo or mosaic APC variant (15–30% arise de novo, EHTG–ESCP 2024) nor recessive MUTYH-associated polyposis; predictive testing for her sister once a family variant is found, and until then 5-yearly colonoscopy from 12–14 for first-degree relatives of someone with clinical FAP, until polyposis appears or they reach national screening age (BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020); and DNA storage when time may be short. Knows that no germline result is recorded for her and never invents one.

name.zh-CN: 方医生（放射科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 按记录原样解读PET-CT：盆壁、腹膜后及左锁骨上淋巴结，右髋臼、L3、L5异常摄取，报告考虑转移；左肾上腺饱满，不除外转移。不补充记录中没有的SUV值、病灶大小或肾上腺密度。被问到时说明哪些病灶在技术上可以经皮取材（例如可触及的锁骨上淋巴结可在超声引导下穿刺），以及全脊柱MRI可评估脊髓和马尾是否受压；MRI、膀胱扫描和下肢静脉超声的结果都没有记录。
knowledge.en: Reads the PET-CT exactly as recorded: abnormal uptake in pelvic-wall, retroperitoneal and left supraclavicular nodes, the right acetabulum, L3 and L5, reported as metastases; a bulky left adrenal with metastasis not excluded. Adds no SUV values, sizes or adrenal density, which are not recorded. When asked, says which lesions are technically reachable percutaneously (the palpable supraclavicular node, for instance, under ultrasound) and that a whole-spine MRI shows whether the cord or cauda equina is compressed; no MRI, bladder scan or leg vein ultrasound result is recorded.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：直肠癌术后的骨痛——从分期取材、遗传咨询到持续照护
title.en: Debrief: bone pain after rectal cancer — from staging and tissue to genetics and continuing care

conclusion.zh-CN: 29岁女性，青春期起反复腹痛、腹泻、便血十几年（1.0.0版英文提取为17年），早年未特殊治疗。全结肠多发息肉（管状及绒毛管状腺瘤）伴直肠中高分化腺癌、淋巴结6/27阳性，行直肠及全结肠切除、回肠造口，术后12次FOLFOX6化疗；临床及病理诊断家族性腺瘤性息肉病，没有记录胚系检测结果；父母和姐姐肠镜无明显异常。右髋痛3个月入院，左锁骨上约1 cm质硬、活动差的淋巴结，右髋及腰椎轻压痛；PET-CT示盆壁、腹膜后及左锁骨上淋巴结和右髋臼、L3、L5异常摄取，考虑转移，左肾上腺饱满、不除外转移。予骨保护及髋部、腰椎放疗（剂量栏记为4000 Gy和5000 Gy），住院时疼痛缓解，之后仍持续；她拒绝进一步全身化疗。数月后出现下肢及外阴水肿、排尿困难，建议住院，她仍拒绝；之后的结局没有记录。按今天的指南还应做到、而报告没有记录的是：从可及的转移灶取材并检测MMR、RAS、BRAF；先为患者本人做胚系检测；处理肾上腺之前先查甲氧基肾上腺素类；用骨改良药物前先查口腔；新出现排尿困难时24小时内MRI并给予地塞米松；向放疗科核实真实的放疗剂量；无论她如何选择，都尽早提供姑息治疗、保持联系。
conclusion.en: A 29-year-old woman had more than ten years (17 in the English extraction of version 1.0.0) of recurrent abdominal pain, diarrhoea and bleeding beginning in adolescence, without specific treatment in the early years. Multiple polyps throughout the colon (tubular and tubulovillous adenomas) and a moderately to well differentiated rectal adenocarcinoma with 6 of 27 nodes positive were treated by rectal and total colonic resection with an ileostomy, then 12 cycles of FOLFOX6; familial adenomatous polyposis was diagnosed clinically and pathologically, with no germline result recorded, and her parents' and older sister's colonoscopies showed nothing obvious. She was admitted with three months of right hip pain, a hard, poorly mobile left supraclavicular node of about 1 cm and mild right hip and lumbar tenderness; PET-CT showed abnormal uptake considered metastatic in pelvic-wall, retroperitoneal and left supraclavicular nodes, the right acetabulum, L3 and L5, with a bulky left adrenal in which metastasis was not excluded. She received bone protection and radiotherapy to the hip and lumbar spine (dose entries recorded as 4000 Gy and 5000 Gy); the pain eased in hospital but persisted afterwards, and she declined further systemic chemotherapy. Months later she had lower-limb and vulval oedema and difficulty passing urine and declined the admission she was advised to have; nothing later is recorded. What today's guidance asks for, and the report does not record: tissue from an accessible metastasis with MMR, RAS and BRAF testing; germline testing of the patient first; metanephrines before anything is done about the adrenal; a dental check before a bone-modifying agent; an MRI within 24 hours and dexamethasone for the new bladder symptom; the true radiotherapy doses from the radiotherapy department; and early palliative care and an open door, whatever she decides.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 淋巴结阳性直肠癌治疗后新出现骨痛，又摸到质硬、活动差的左锁骨上淋巴结和腰椎压痛：在证实之前按转移复发处理；她已做过的PET-CT就是此刻要读的分期检查，而不是先试验性止痛、理疗。
keyReasoning.en: New bone pain after a node-positive rectal cancer, with a hard, poorly mobile left supraclavicular node and lumbar tenderness, is metastatic recurrence until proven otherwise; the PET-CT she has already had is the staging study to read now, not something to defer behind a trial of analgesia and physiotherapy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 组织要从最容易、最安全的病灶取（可触及的淋巴结），先查血小板和凝血；它同时完成两件事——证实复发，并提供决定全身治疗的MMR、RAS、BRAF状态。性质不明的肾上腺不是取材目标：先查甲氧基肾上腺素类。
keyReasoning.en: Tissue comes from the easiest, safest lesion — the palpable node — once platelets and clotting are checked, and it does two jobs: it confirms the recurrence and gives the MMR, RAS and BRAF status that sets systemic treatment. The indeterminate adrenal is not the target; metanephrines come first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 30岁前患癌、全结肠多发腺瘤，需要先为她本人做胚系检测；父母和姐姐肠镜正常，排除不了APC新发变异、嵌合或隐性遗传的MUTYH相关息肉病，找到她的变异才能给姐姐做有意义的检测。
keyReasoning.en: Cancer before 30 with multiple adenomas throughout the colon calls for germline testing of the patient herself; normal colonoscopies in her parents and sister exclude neither a de novo or mosaic APC variant nor recessive MUTYH-associated polyposis, and only her variant makes her sister's test meaningful.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 疼痛性骨转移要局部治疗（放疗，MRI指导），全身保护（口腔检查后用骨改良药物，补钙和维生素D）；出院前她必须知道脊髓压迫的警示症状和该找谁。
keyReasoning.en: Painful bone metastases are treated locally (radiotherapy, planned with an MRI) and protected systemically (a bone-modifying agent after a dental check, with calcium and vitamin D); she must leave knowing the warning signs of cord compression and whom to call.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 数月后，有腰椎转移的患者出现排尿困难，就是可能的脊髓或马尾受压：24小时内MRI、地塞米松；她拒绝住院时评估决策能力、商定她能接受的处理，而不是结束照护。记录里“数千戈瑞”的剂量不能照着用，真实剂量要向放疗科核实。
keyReasoning.en: Months later, difficulty passing urine with lumbar metastases is possible cord or cauda equina compression: MRI within 24 hours and dexamethasone; when she declines admission, assess capacity and negotiate what she will accept — never end her care. A record of thousands of gray cannot be acted on; the true doses come from the radiotherapy department.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据1.0.0版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明哪种处理更好，也不能说明预后。病例没有记录生命体征、化验、息肉数量、胚系和肿瘤分子结果、任何转移灶活检、骨保护药物、真实放疗剂量、她拒绝的原因以及之后的病程；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show which management is better, nor anything about prognosis. No vital signs, blood results, polyp count, germline or tumour molecular result, biopsy of a metastasis, bone-protective drug, true radiotherapy dose, her reasons for declining or later course are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征、体重和化验结果（血常规、凝血、血钙、肾功能、CEA）。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, weight and blood results at any point (blood count, clotting, calcium, renal function, CEA).

unknowns.zh-CN: 息肉的数量；肠镜、手术和化疗的时间及她当时的年龄；pT/pN分期和切缘；肿瘤MMR/MSI、RAS、BRAF状态；是否做过上消化道内镜，有无结肠外表现。
unknowns.en: The number of polyps; the dates of the colonoscopy, operation and chemotherapy and her age then; the pT/pN stage and margins; the tumour's MMR/MSI, RAS and BRAF status; whether an upper GI endoscopy was done, and any extracolonic features.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胚系检测（APC、MUTYH等）是否做过及其结果；家人是否接受过遗传咨询。
unknowns.en: Whether germline testing (APC, MUTYH and others) was done and its result; whether her family had genetic counselling.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何转移部位的活检；脊柱MRI；肾上腺的生化检查、CT密度和FDG摄取值；各病灶的SUV值和大小。
unknowns.en: A biopsy of any metastatic site; an MRI of the spine; adrenal biochemistry, CT density and FDG uptake; SUV values and sizes of the lesions.

unknowns.zh-CN: 骨保护药物的名称和剂量；放疗的真实剂量、分次、照射野和日期（记录为4000 Gy和5000 Gy，各对应哪个部位不清楚）；用过的止痛药。
unknowns.en: The bone-protective drug and dose; the true radiotherapy doses, fractions, fields and dates (recorded as 4000 Gy and 5000 Gy, with the site of each not stated); the analgesics she received.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她拒绝化疗和住院的原因；数月后水肿和排尿困难的原因；当时的神经系统检查；此后的病程和生存情况。
unknowns.en: Her reasons for declining chemotherapy and admission; the cause of the later oedema and urinary difficulty; any neurological examination then; what followed, and her survival.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复发要有组织证实，而且这份组织一举两得：转移或复发灶组织是治疗预测性生物标志物检测的首选标本，没有时原发灶组织也可接受（ASCP/CAP/AMP/ASCO 2017）；MMR/MSI、RAS、BRAF决定全身治疗的选择。记录与现行做法：本病例只记录了PET-CT“考虑转移”，没有任何转移灶活检和生物标志物结果。
teachingPoints.en: Confirm recurrence in tissue, and make that tissue do double duty: metastatic or recurrent tissue is the preferred specimen for treatment-predictive biomarkers, with the primary acceptable when none is available (ASCP/CAP/AMP/ASCO 2017), and MMR/MSI, RAS and BRAF set the systemic options. Then and now: the report records PET-CT lesions 'considered metastases' and no biopsy of a metastatic site or biomarker result.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肿瘤患者性质不明的肾上腺病灶：先测血或尿甲氧基肾上腺素类（ESE/ENSAT 2023，R.6.3.1）；只有在已排除嗜铬细胞瘤、影像不能确定为良性、且病理会改变处理时才考虑活检（R.6.3.5），否则影像随访（R.6.3.4）。FAP患者肾上腺肿块的发生率是一般人群的2–3倍（EHTG–ESCP 2024），“饱满”不等于转移。
teachingPoints.en: An indeterminate adrenal lesion in a patient with cancer: measure plasma or urine metanephrines (ESE/ENSAT 2023, R.6.3.1); consider biopsy only if phaeochromocytoma is excluded, imaging is not conclusively benign and histology would change management (R.6.3.5), and otherwise follow it with imaging (R.6.3.4). Adrenal masses are 2–3 times more common in FAP than in the general population (EHTG–ESCP 2024), so 'bulky' is not proof of metastasis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 遗传：30岁及以下的结直肠癌和60岁前累计≥10枚腺瘤都是胚系多基因检测的指征（BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020，表2），先检测患者本人。15%–30%的APC变异为新发（EHTG–ESCP 2024），MUTYH相关息肉病为隐性遗传，家人肠镜正常并不能让人放心；家族变异明确前，临床诊断FAP者的一级亲属从12–14岁起每5年肠镜，直到出现表型或到达国家筛查年龄（BSG 2020）。记录与现行做法：报告只有临床及病理诊断FAP，没有胚系结果。
teachingPoints.en: Genetics: colorectal cancer at 30 or younger and 10 or more adenomas before 60 are indications for germline panel testing (BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2020, Table 2); test the affected person first. With 15–30% of APC variants de novo (EHTG–ESCP 2024) and MUTYH polyposis recessive, normal family colonoscopies do not reassure; until a family variant is known, first-degree relatives of someone with clinical FAP have 5-yearly colonoscopy from 12–14 until polyposis appears or national screening age (BSG 2020). Then and now: the report gives a clinical and pathological FAP diagnosis with no germline result.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 疼痛性骨转移：无并发症时单次8 Gy放疗 [I, A]；预计生存≥3个月的实体瘤患者用唑来膦酸或地舒单抗 [I, B]，用药前做口腔检查 [III, A]，并补充钙和维生素D [I, A]（ESMO 2020骨健康指南）。脊柱转移：1周内MRI指导治疗，并让她知道出现新症状时该联系谁（NICE NG234 2023）。记录与现行做法：报告记录了骨保护和髋部、腰椎放疗，但没有记录药物、口腔检查和放疗分次。
teachingPoints.en: Painful bone metastases: a single 8 Gy fraction when uncomplicated [I, A]; zoledronate or denosumab for solid tumours with a life expectancy of 3 months or more [I, B], after a dental evaluation [III, A] and with calcium and vitamin D [I, A] (ESMO 2020 bone health). Spinal metastases: an MRI within a week to guide treatment, and she must know whom to contact if new symptoms appear (NICE NG234 2023). Then and now: the report records bone protection and radiotherapy to the hip and lumbar spine, but not the drug, a dental check or the fractionation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 转移性脊髓压迫：肿瘤患者出现膀胱或直肠功能障碍，就是脊髓压迫的症状——立即联系MSCC协调员、尽快且一定在24小时内MRI、有神经症状或体征时地塞米松16 mg（NICE NG234 2023，1.3.2、1.5.2、1.8.1）。再次放疗前必须考虑既往疗程的总生物等效剂量（1.10.10）；记录为4000 Gy和5000 Gy的数字无法据此评估，必须向放疗科核实，不能凭猜测换算。
teachingPoints.en: Metastatic spinal cord compression: bladder or bowel dysfunction in a person with cancer is a symptom of cord compression — contact the MSCC coordinator immediately, MRI as soon as possible and always within 24 hours, dexamethasone 16 mg for neurological symptoms or signs (NICE NG234 2023, 1.3.2, 1.5.2, 1.8.1). Further radiotherapy must take account of the total biological equivalent dose of the previous course (1.10.10) — impossible from entries of 4000 Gy and 5000 Gy, which must be checked with the radiotherapy department, never converted on a guess.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 拒绝治疗不等于拒绝照护：针对具体决定评估决策能力（推定有能力；决定不明智不等于没有能力——以英国《2005年精神能力法》为例），商定她能接受的方案并交代返诊指征，在抗肿瘤治疗之外（或代替它）尽早提供专科姑息治疗（ASCO 2024）。
teachingPoints.en: Declining treatment is not declining care: assess capacity for the specific decision (capacity is presumed, and an unwise decision is not incapacity — Mental Capacity Act 2005 as one legal model), negotiate what she will accept, safety-net, and offer early specialist palliative care alongside, or instead of, anticancer treatment (ASCO 2024).
